body.message:
Hello Esteban, Roman, hope you are doing well. First of all, we apologize for the inconvenience. Roaches may be attracted to leftover food in the kitchen. We kindly ask that the unit be kept clean and tidy, as it was in good condition upon check-in.

We have arranged for our pest control team to visit tomorrow and will confirm the timing with you shortly.

Thank you for your understanding.
